ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High local contrast between sparse high-intensity (white) point-features and a dominant low-intensity (black/dark gray) background; global distribution is heavily skewed toward <10% intensity values.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes with scattered, non-contiguous white circular clusters (rosettes) concentrated in the medial and mid-lobe regions; one distinct white linear mark is visible on the distal left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with approximately a 120-degree interior angle and shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature originating from the median notch, tapering toward pointed and slightly irregular distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white ring-like pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across both lobes, with higher density on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal white linear disruption on the left lobe; several shorter, less defined linear marks visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white rosette scarring and linear rake-like marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge shows localized irregularities and possible minor notches on the distal right lobe tip.
